adminSteps: open the path, type 'ZZ' in Discount code, leave Discount value empty, click Save. Two kinds of error: the 'Discount value' number field (error line inside the field, 6 below the control) and the 'Specific collections' picker (custom line: 16px icon, gap 2, text, 7 below the control). The invalid control is the picker's field backdrop. The probe reads the shadow as 'yes'; the full value is rgb(235,0,20) 0 0 0 1px plus the three 0.04 drop shadows and rgba(224,61,80,.05) inset, as in the entry. Root is the picker error row.
